requirements.title: ALLOCATED argument is allocatable array or scalar
requirements.definition: ARRAY shall be an allocatable array, and SCALAR shall be an allocatable scalar.

pending.array-allocatable-argument: Future source-control plan only: compile a conforming allocatable array argument before and after ALLOCATE as the positive control; do not require a diagnostic for a nonallocatable array because this is an unnumbered Clause 16 program restriction.
pending.scalar-allocatable-argument: Future source-control plan only: compile a conforming allocatable scalar argument before and after ALLOCATE as the positive control; do not require a diagnostic for a nonallocatable scalar because this is an unnumbered Clause 16 program restriction.

requirements.title: ALLOCATED result is default logical scalar
requirements.definition: ALLOCATED returns a default logical scalar.

pending.default-logical-result: Evaluate ALLOCATED on an allocatable scalar with a result variable initialized to the opposite logical value; assert KIND(result)==KIND(.false.) and the expected allocation status.
pending.scalar-result: Evaluate ALLOCATED on an allocatable array and assign to a scalar logical initialized to the opposite value; assert scalar assignment succeeds and the value matches allocation status.

requirements.title: ALLOCATED reports allocated and unallocated status
requirements.definition: ALLOCATED is true if the allocatable argument is allocated and false if it is unallocated.

pending.allocated-true: Declare an allocatable integer array, allocate it to a nonzero size, initialize a logical result to .false., then assert ALLOCATED(array) is .true.; mutation removes ALLOCATE to make the status observation load-bearing.
pending.unallocated-false: Declare an allocatable scalar and leave it unallocated after explicitly setting a logical result to .true.; assert ALLOCATED(scalar) is .false.; mutation adds ALLOCATE to make the unallocated observation load-bearing.

accounting.rationale: Description defines the intrinsic result concept: Allocation status of allocatable variable.
Classifies ALLOCATED as inquiry function; executable obligations for elemental/transformational/inquiry classes are owned by the intrinsic framework, not this descriptive unit.
Argument restrictions are recorded as unnumbered program requirements with no diagnostic facet.

review_rationale: Source registration for 16.9.8-16.9.14: ADJUSTL, ADJUSTR, AIMAG, AINT, ALL, ALLOCATED and ANINT (batch180). Every unit verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds; the ALL plans now use a rank-2 mask so DIM genuinely changes the result rank, the zero-size .TRUE. result has a non-vacuous companion, and the new catalogues assert no review state. Source accounting only.
